channel.title: Seven Layers — articles
channel.description: Plain-English articles on websites, marketing, security and emerging technology for small businesses.

item.title: Should you let AI crawlers read your website?
item.description: There are three kinds of AI crawler, and blocking the wrong one quietly removes you from AI answers. What each does, and the setting that may have changed.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Post-quantum encryption: is your website ready?
item.description: Quantum computers cannot break your encryption yet, but the switch to new algorithms is already under way in your browser. What changed and what to do.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Passkeys: the end of passwords, explained plainly
item.description: Billions of passkeys are now in use and phishing cannot steal them. What a passkey is, which accounts to switch first, and the one thing to plan for.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: MCP explained: how AI assistants plug into your tools
item.description: The Model Context Protocol is becoming the standard way AI assistants connect to business software. What it is, why it matters, and how to use it safely.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: AI browsers are here. What they mean for your website
item.description: Browsers that click, fill forms and compare on a person's behalf now ship from OpenAI, Google, Perplexity and Microsoft. How to make your site work for them.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Deepfake fraud: the cheap defences that actually work
item.description: A convincing fake voice now takes seconds of audio. The defences are old-fashioned and nearly free: callbacks, a change-of-bank-details rule, and time.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Vibe coding: what it means if you're not a developer
item.description: You can now describe an app and get working software. Where that is genuinely useful for a small business, where it bites, and when to call a professional.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: On-device AI: why useful models are getting smaller
item.description: AI that runs on your own laptop or phone is private, fast and free to use. What changed in the hardware, what it is good for, and where it still falls short.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Content Credentials: proving your photos are real
item.description: Phones and cameras now sign photos at the moment they are taken. What Content Credentials prove, what they do not, and why online sellers should care.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Digital product passports: what EU sellers need to know
item.description: The EU's product passport registry went live in July 2026 and batteries need passports from February 2027. What a passport is, who needs one, and when.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Static, serverless and the edge: how hosting quietly changed
item.description: The model most small-business sites still use was designed for 2005. What replaced it, why it's faster and cheaper, and where it genuinely doesn't fit.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: DNS explained: the part that breaks at the worst moment
item.description: A, CNAME, MX, TXT, TTL — the handful of records that decide whether people reach your site and your email arrives. Plus why 'propagation' is mostly a myth.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Your domain is a security asset. Lock it down.
item.description: A hijacked domain redirects your traffic, intercepts your email and impersonates you at your own address. Four controls that prevent nearly all of it.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: SPF, DKIM and DMARC: why your email stopped arriving
item.description: Since 2024 the big providers reject unauthenticated mail rather than filtering it. Three DNS records decide whether you reach the inbox or the bin.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: What "modern hosting" actually means, and how to check yours
item.description: HTTP/3, TLS 1.3, IPv6, HTTP/2 — four things you can check in two minutes that tell you whether your host is maintained or coasting on 2015.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Managed WordPress hosting: worth the premium?
item.description: Four to ten times the price of shared hosting for the same site. What you're actually buying, and the honest test for whether it's worth it for you.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Moving a website without downtime (or losing your email)
item.description: Migrations go wrong in predictable ways. The TTL trick, the order of operations, and the one mistake that takes email down for a day.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Green hosting: what's real and what's a certificate
item.description: Data centres use about as much electricity as aviation. Green hosting is a real choice — but there is a difference between buying power and buying paperwork.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Managing multiple iDRACs: the one-tab-per-server problem
item.description: iDRAC is excellent at one server and says nothing about fifty. How teams actually answer estate-wide questions, and the point at which tabs stop scaling.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise: where it fits, and where it doesn't
item.description: OME is capable, free with the hardware and the right first answer for most Dell estates. An honest look at what it does well and when teams outgrow it.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Why we charge £999 when agencies quote £5,000
item.description: UK agencies charge £1,500 to £10,000 for a small business site. We start at £999. Here is exactly where the difference comes from — and when to pay more.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: What a domain name actually is (and who really owns it)
item.description: You don't buy a domain, you rent it. Here's what registries, registrars and nameservers each do, and why knowing the difference saves you at the worst moment.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Choosing a domain in 2026: .com, .co.uk, or something newer?
item.description: The extension matters less than it used to and the renewal price matters more. How to pick a name, and the pricing trick that catches almost everyone.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: The .io question: when a domain depends on a country existing
item.description: Thousands of tech businesses run on .io, a domain tied to a territory being handed to Mauritius. A real case study in why the extension is a business decision.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: What web hosting actually is, and what you're paying for
item.description: Hosting is renting a computer that is always on. Here's what separates £3 a month from £300, and which of those differences will ever matter to you.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Types of hosting compared: shared, VPS, cloud, managed, static
item.description: Five kinds of hosting, what each is genuinely for, and the honest answer to which one your site needs — including when the cheapest option is the right one.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Buy Now Pay Later at the UK checkout: worth it or not?
item.description: 42% of UK adults have used BNPL and half of retailers report a revenue lift. The honest trade-off: fees, the 2026 regulation, and who it suits.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Windows 10 is out of support. What that means for your business.
item.description: Standard support ended in October 2025. Without Extended Security Updates, new flaws stay unfixed. How to work out what you have and what to do.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Cyber Essentials changed in April 2026. MFA is now pass or fail.
item.description: Version 3.3 landed on 27 April 2026. Missing MFA on a cloud service is now an automatic fail — no warnings, no exception for paid-only tiers.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Your Google Business Profile is not set-and-forget any more
item.description: Local search leaned harder on relevance and engagement through 2026. Completeness, activity and answered questions now separate first place from fifth.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: The European Accessibility Act and UK businesses
item.description: Since June 2025, e-commerce sold into the EU must be accessible, and UK sellers can be in scope. What it requires, the narrow 2030 rule, and what to do first.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: AI shopping agents are buying things. Can they buy from you?
item.description: Google, OpenAI and Shopify shipped protocols letting AI agents buy. If your product data is not machine-readable, the agent picks a competitor.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Your rankings held and your traffic fell. That's AI Overviews.
item.description: Same positions, fewer clicks? Nothing broke — Google started answering the question itself. What changed, how to confirm it, and what to do next.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: How to get cited by AI search when you're a small business
item.description: AI answers cite sources, and getting into that list is winnable for a small site. It takes specificity and currency, not a bigger budget.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Social media for businesses that hate posting

item.title: Technical SEO: the fixes that actually move rankings
item.description: Most technical SEO advice is a checklist of things that change nothing. Here are the problems that genuinely hold sites back, in the order worth fixing them.

item.title: How to tell whether your marketing is actually working
item.description: Traffic is up, enquiries are flat, and the report is forty pages. A simple way to judge whether the money is earning — without becoming an analyst.

item.title: The five emails every small business should have running
item.description: Not a newsletter nobody reads. Five automated messages that do their work quietly, and the order to build them in.
item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Your logo is not your brand

item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: Why your Google Ads budget disappears

item.dc:creator: Aftab Ahmad

item.title: The startup website: what to build before you have a product

item.title: Restaurant websites: the five things people actually came to find

item.title: The construction website that wins bigger jobs
item.description: Trades lose work to competitors who are no better, just easier to believe. What a website has to prove, and the one section that does most of it.

item.title: When custom software is worth it (and when a spreadsheet is fine)

item.title: How to keep a server hardware inventory that stays true

item.title: What is iDRAC? Dell's out-of-band controller in plain English
item.description: Every Dell PowerEdge server has a small computer inside that runs whether the server is on or off. What iDRAC does, why it matters, and where it stops.
